item.title: OWASP AIBOM Generator
item.description:
Overview

OWASP AIBOM Generator is an open source tool that takes a Hugging Face model ID, retrieves the model card metadata, and generates an AI SBOM in CycloneDX format. It is maintained by the OWASP Gen AI Security Project, and its distinguishing feature is scoring how complete the generated BOM is.

Unlike cdxgen, which identifies dependencies quickly but leaves licenses empty, this tool fills in the license, authors, and external references written in the model card. It is a good starting point for the license review required by 3.5 License Obligations.
